paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 7.6 as of August 12, 2026, with a 6.74 percent change from the prior close and a 20.44 percent change over a window of 23 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

The recent news is driven by the appointment of a new CEO, with Fermi naming Lee McIntire to the position effective August 11, as reported by Yahoo Finance on August 13. This news has been reflected in social media, with 13 new posts in the last 24 hours, including discussions about the new CEO and the company's earnings.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of a director, and the issuance of convertible senior notes. Specifically, an 8-K filing on July 23 announced the appointment of four new officers, while an 8-K filing on July 15 disclosed the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing.
